title: Translation catalog
responsibility: Read registered translation dictionaries from one source revision without executing application code.

inputs.name: translationCatalog.tree
inputs.description: Selected-revision source tree from which translation declarations and dictionaries are read.

inputs.name: translationCatalog.units
inputs.description: Optional registered units used to identify translation sources; defaults to an empty list.

inputs.name: flattenMessages.input
inputs.description: Dictionary object containing string messages or nested dictionaries; invalid shapes are rejected.

inputs.name: flattenMessages.prefix
inputs.description: Optional dotted path prepended to flattened message keys; defaults to an empty string.

inputs.name: translationMessages.text
inputs.description: TypeScript source containing static translation imports, registrations and dictionary declarations.

outputs.name: catalog
outputs.description: Static language values, literal caller links and unreadable source gaps from that revision.
